summary: Trio Petroleum Corp filed an 8-K to disclose a non-binding Letter of Intent extension with Heavy Sweet Oil LLC for the acquisition of certain oil and gas assets at P.R. Spring, Utah. The original production-rate condition requiring 40 bbl/d for 30 days from two wells has not been met; the parties extended the deadline to May 15, 2028, with further extension possible at Trio's discretion. No price, premium, or financial terms were updated. The filing is procedural—extending a pre-existing LOI milestone—not a definitive deal event. Watch for whether production milestones are achieved or an alternative path emerges.
